edges.reason: Constructor and initialize assign msg.sender-derived admin, the root of trust for privileged functions.
transferTokens is invoked with msg.sender as spender/src, so caller identity drives allowance and balance updates.
mintInternal passes msg.sender as minter into mintFresh.
Redeem flow passes msg.sender as redeemer into redeemFresh.
Borrow flow passes msg.sender as borrower into borrowFresh.
Repay flow passes msg.sender as payer into repayBorrowFresh.
seize() deliberately uses msg.sender as the seizer token, and the parameter must never be trusted instead.
Only admin (msg.sender) may call _setPendingAdmin.
Only pendingAdmin (msg.sender) may call _acceptAdmin.
_become requires msg.sender to equal the Unitroller admin.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == admin before swapping the delegate target.
_setComptroller requires msg.sender == admin before replacing the policy contract.
refreshCompSpeeds is restricted by msg.sender == tx.origin, a weak EOA gate that can be gamed by intermediaries.
Anyone can trigger the Unitroller fallback which delegatecalls arbitrary msg.data to the implementation.
accrueInterest writes the recomputed borrowIndexNew to borrowIndex.
accrueInterest writes totalBorrowsNew into totalBorrows.
accrueInterest writes totalReservesNew into totalReserves.
accrueInterest checkpoints the current block number into accrualBlockNumber.
mintFresh adds mintTokens to totalSupply via addUInt, requiring overflow safety.
mintFresh credits accountTokens[minter] with the newly minted tokens.
mintFresh calls doTransferIn to pull the underlying asset into the market.
mintFresh calls comptroller.mintVerify after state updates; an external hook can re-enter if guards fail.
redeemFresh calls doTransferOut to an external token/address after computing amounts.
redeemFresh calls comptroller.redeemVerify, an external hook that could re-enter.
borrowFresh calls doTransferOut to the borrower before recording the borrow state.
borrowFresh invokes comptroller.borrowAllowed/borrowVerify hooks.
borrowFresh adds borrowAmount to totalBorrows via addUInt.
borrowFresh writes the new principal and interest index into accountBorrows.
repayBorrowFresh subtracts actualRepayAmount from totalBorrows.
repayBorrowFresh calls doTransferIn to collect the repayment.
repayBorrowFresh calls comptroller.repayBorrowVerify after effects.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls comptroller.liquidateBorrowVerify at the end of liquidation.
When the collateral is this market, liquidateBorrowFresh calls seizeInternal directly instead of an external call.
seizeInternal subtracts from the borrower and adds to the liquidator in accountTokens.
seizeInternal calls comptroller.seizeVerify, an external hook.
transferTokens writes srcTokensNew and dstTokensNew into accountTokens.
transferTokens decrements transferAllowances[src][spender].
transferTokens calls comptroller.transferAllowed and transferVerify external hooks.
claimComp ultimately triggers cheese.transfer to move accrued rewards to the holder.
refreshCompSpeedsInternal writes the newly computed speed into compSpeeds.
Reward distribution updates compAccrued for holders.
refreshCompSpeedsInternal reads oracle prices to compute market utility.
refreshCompSpeeds delegates all recomputation to refreshCompSpeedsInternal.
claimComp distributes borrower/supplier rewards into compAccrued before transfer.
delegateTo executes callee.delegatecall(data), forwarding storage context.
delegateAndReturn delegatecalls implementation with raw msg.data.
_setImplementation uses delegateTo to run become/resign hooks on the delegate.
delegateAndReturn targets the implementation address for its delegatecall.
Comptroller hook calls are dispatched on the comptroller state variable.
_reduceReservesFresh transfers reduced reserves out to the admin.
_reduceReservesFresh computes totalReservesNew = totalReserves - reduceAmount.
_setReserveFactorFresh stores newReserveFactorMantissa into reserveFactorMantissa.
_addReservesFresh calls doTransferIn to pull the added reserves into the market.
_setComptroller overwrites the comptroller policy contract after the admin check.
mintAmount flows into mintFresh to determine tokens minted.
borrowAmount flows into borrowFresh for balance and cash checks.
redeemTokens flows into redeemFresh to compute the underlying payout.
seizeTokens flows into seizeInternal to move collateral balances.
repayAmount flows into repayBorrowFresh, with uint(-1) meaning repay all.
newPendingAdmin flows into _setPendingAdmin as the next admin candidate.
addAmount flows into _addReserves as the reserve contribution.
reduceAmount flows into _reduceReserves and is bounded by totalReserves.
newReserveFactorMantissa flows into _setReserveFactor.
borrowRateMantissa is returned by the interest rate model and bounded in accrueInterest.
currentBlockNumber drives the block delta used for interest accrual.
The allowed code returned by the comptroller hook gates every market action.
exchangeRateMantissa is used to convert the mint amount into cTokens.
RedeemLocalVars carries intermediate redeem tokens/amounts and supply deltas.

normalization_plan.reason: mintAmount is only meaningful as an argument of the mint flow; fold it into the mintFresh function node.
borrowAmount exists solely to parameterize borrowFresh balance and cash checks.
redeemTokens only feeds the redeemFresh amount computation.
seizeTokens is consumed only by seizeInternal balance updates.
repayAmount parameterizes repayBorrowFresh and its uint(-1) special case.
addAmount only parameterizes the reserve addition flow.
reduceAmount only parameterizes the reserve reduction flow.
newReserveFactorMantissa is only validated and stored by _setReserveFactor.
borrowRateMantissa is a transient local of accrueInterest, not a stored value.
currentBlockNumber is a transient local of accrueInterest.
allowed is merely the return value of the comptroller policy hook call.
exchangeRateMantissa is a transient local of mintFresh used to size the mint.
RedeemLocalVars is a stack-limit workaround local to redeemFresh.
